description: Unit tests for the midi_manager_usb component, testing device initialization, sending and receiving MIDI data, and device attachment handling.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A simple logger class to accumulate log messages.

classes.name: FakeUsbMidiDevice
classes.description: A mock implementation of UsbMidiDevice for testing, with methods to set descriptors and simulate sending data.

classes.name: FakeMidiManagerClient
classes.description: A mock implementation of MidiManagerClient to capture MIDI data reception and port info.

classes.name: TestUsbMidiDeviceFactory
classes.description: A factory for creating FakeUsbMidiDevice instances for testing.

classes.name: MidiManagerUsbForTesting
classes.description: A subclass of MidiManagerUsb with a method to manually trigger initialization completion.

classes.name: MidiManagerFactoryForTesting
classes.description: A factory for creating MidiManagerUsbForTesting instances, managing device factory and manager references.

classes.name: MidiManagerUsbTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up and tearing down MIDI USB manager tests, with helper methods for initialization and callback handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test MIDI manager session with a fake device.

methods.name: IsInitializationCallbackInvoked
methods.description: Checks if the initialization callback has been invoked.

methods.name: GetInitializationResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the initialization process.

methods.name: RunCallbackUntilCallbackInvoked
methods.description: Runs the device enumeration callback until the session is complete.

methods.name: input_ports
methods.description: Returns the list of input ports detected.

methods.name: output_ports
methods.description: Returns the list of output ports detected.
